description: Validate an EU VAT identification number live against the official EU VIES service, with registered company name and address where the member state discloses them. Checks the national format first. Not charged if the member state service is temporarily unavailable. Params: vat_number (with country prefix, e.g. NL004495445B01, DE811569869) or vat_number + country_code. Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"vat_number":"NL004495445B01"}.

country_code.description: Two-letter EU code if the number has no prefix (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland)

vat_number.description: VAT number, ideally with EU country prefix

name: vat_validate
title: EU VAT Number Validation (VIES)
